challenge.back_up: proceed — the orchestrator ruled the disposition: cast and build it on a branch, 69cd its consumer.
challenge.better_approach: Keeping scratch HOMEs on red would also keep the evidence, but it widens every proof's disk and lives in the tester, not the bus; the bus is the only place that knows its wake state at the instant of the bounce, so the line is written there once.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the next real bounce happens under the Dell q-job load at all (n=2 in one day, 0 of 5 reproduction shapes); if it never recurs the instrument is still the record a future one leaves.
challenge.prior_art: Grepped CairnCommons/tickets and git log --all for no_receiver and bounce: 41f57726a609, bc0bbfd33a71, cd2d27fe3261, d0c8c4b4283e, 7cb1989e7825, b3386f431ae3, b30069239480, c2036433beaf, eff2fb9810de, 4a105acd1190, 60cc220da787, 3bf728e5328d, 6357c2eeff7c, 71d1bbfa98b0 build or route the bounce; none records the bus's wake state at it.
challenge.real_collision: None: the bus charter intends that untaken mail bounces to its sender; this adds a record beside that act and changes no delivery path. RULE 1 holds: the run dir path is mirrored from the account home, no tester import.

answers.falsifier: A provoked bounce inside a scratch-HOME bus with a test id writes one line at the account's run dir naming every field, and the line still reads after the scratch HOME is swept; a delivered ask writes no line; an unwritable destination still bounces and names bounce_record_failed. Wrong intent if the next real bounce's line does not discriminate between 69cd's candidate causes.
answers.from_idea: none, because the consumer is the origin: ticket 69cd150dc116 (its measured, commons commit ad15701a, records five green reproduction shapes and both real reds lost with their swept scratch HOMEs); the bounce is made at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/server.py
answers.how: In BusProcess.no_receiver (cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/server.py) capture hook/_wired state before and after hold_name, the held shim's class, and the bus's pid and start time (captured at __init__); append one line to the account's tester run dir (runs/<CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID>/bus-bounces.jsonl, resolved from the account home, never HOME) inside a test run, else to the account bus log; a write failure emits bounce_record_failed and never stops the bounce.
answers.traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured: 69cd's D1 rests on a cause the code argues against and the two reds left no record) and Law 7 (errors permanent in records of truth: the bounce's evidence was swept with its scratch HOME).
answers.what: Every no_receiver bounce the bus server makes leaves one JSON line, at a place that outlives the scratch HOME sweep, naming the bus's wake state at that moment: whether a delivery hook stood for the addressee, whether it was in _wired before and after the wake, the held shim's class, and the bus pid and start time.

bullets.text: 69cd's two real reds were lost with their swept scratch HOMEs; the bus instrument writes each bounce's wake state to the account run dir so the next one is measured, not narrated.
